facts.note: Antonio Rebollo Liñán (born 19 June 1955) is a Spanish Paralympic archer.
Rebollo lit the Olympic Cauldron at the Barcelona opening ceremony
He contracted the disease (polio) at eight months old, affecting both legs.
He won silver at the 1984 Stoke Mandeville Games, bronze at the 1988 Seoul Games, and silver again at the 1992 Barcelona Games.
